statements.statement: The service is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient has diagnosis codes I48.91, I25.10
The patient has diagnosis code R55
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
The ordered service is intended to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The ordered service is intended to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
